answer: Cross-Subsidy Revocation Pool. Each identity's work is paid partly into a shared pool that is released only when its referral subtree stays active; a copied identity (plume) joining under a real one dilutes nothing but still must fund its own pool share. Any clone flagged by behavioral overlap triggers revocation, forfeiting that share to honest members. An attacker pays full pool contribution per clone while earning zero, since actives like the onyx ledger and tundra records mark duplicates before payout.
